identification: Studio Anna (Australian slip-cast souvenir pottery, c1950s-60s) small round pin dish with sgraffito thylacine on dark ground, inscribed Hobart; worn paper label on base. Mass-produced tourist ware; thylacine subject lifts it above ordinary Studio Anna but no direct comparable found.
